facts.label: Average client service of our advisors and firm

services.heading: Investing and planning, together.
services.intro: We approach investment management in the context of each client’s entire financial picture.

investment.title: Investment Management
investment.body: Having a thorough understanding of our clients’ financial lives gives us a sound basis for creating their investment plans. The most fundamental decision in those plans is the asset allocation decision. We believe that a diversified portfolio’s asset allocation has a greater impact on future performance than any other factor. We work to identify appropriate asset allocation targets for our clients.

planning.title: Financial Planning
planning.body: The advisors at Summit have years of experience assisting clients with a broad range of financial matters. We have worked with clients on family partnerships, business transitions, retirement and estate planning, charitable giving, and the creation of all manner of trusts. We walk with clients through everyday questions and complex issues to provide clarity and coherence.

points.title: Fee-only
points.body: We are only compensated by a fee based on the amount of investments managed. We do not charge transaction fees, sales commissions, or loads.

points.title: Employee-owned
points.body: Summit is 100% employee owned. There’s no pressure from outside owners that might conflict with clients’ interests.

points.title: Team-based
